response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       attendee_count,
       CAST(attendee_count AS REAL) / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share
FROM status_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Each attendance row matching an existing event counts as one attendee entry; the share is that status's entry count divided by all matching attendance entries. Events with no attendance entries are excluded.
